name: Amp Musical
description: Résonateur amplifiant les signaux tactiques alliés pour une meilleure coordination sur le champ de bataille chaotique.

subject.archetype: Faceless Android Tactical Coordinator - Cybernetic Ascetic Warrior

loadout.armor_outfit: Ample worn monastic robes crafted from braided cable bundles and thick synthetic fibers in faded monk brown, layered over smooth patinated steel underlayer, shoulder plates of aged white ceramic with pearl gray accents, holographic runic patterns glowing in electric gold
loadout.arsenal: Electrified pilgrim staff with clear electric gold energy crackling along its length, cybernetic prayer wheel device at hip emitting harmonic vibrations, floating rosary of tiny hard drive disks orbiting in synchronized patterns

attitude.behavior: Tactical coordinator positioned at center of shattered amphitheater battlefield with hands raised directing allied unit movements, combat stance with electrified staff raised and ready, body coiled like a spring with weight shifted forward, both arms guiding synchronized strikes
attitude.emotion: Imperturbable monastic focus emanating from smooth featureless metallic faceplate, total serenity despite chaotic harmonic destruction surrounding the figure, eyes tracked through internal sensors locked on approaching threats

palette_names.name: Oxidized Bronze
palette_names.role: Worn mechanical details and cable braiding

palette_names.name: Holographic Gold
palette_names.role: Orbiting runes, mantras, and runic symbols

palette_names.name: Clear Electric Gold
palette_names.role: Staff energy, levitation effects, shockwave rings

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic multi-source with holographic_glow, magical_glow, and blue-white rim lighting from crystalline resonance, electric gold energy emanating from staff creating localized OSL
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic yet transcendent, martial serenity amid destructive harmonic resonance, epic tension between serene ascetic focus and explosive battlefield chaos

camera.angle: Low angle dutch_angle - dynamic upward perspective emphasizing towering crystalline formations and the figure's commanding tactical presence

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater transformed into battlefield, massive crystal formations erupting from harmonic overload, cracked ceiling structures raining resonating fragments, geometric mandala patterns visible in destroyed architecture
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible shockwave rings of golden energy tearing through enemy positions in concentric circles, crystal shards exploding in all directions from resonant overload, entire environment vibrating at lethal frequency causing air to ripple and distort, floating holographic mantras and equations illuminating the chaos, blue-white energy discharge from crystallized surfaces, particle dust suspended in vibrating air
